name: bld4_pow_prime_monoidHom_center_of_card_prime_cube
statement: (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (G : Type*) [Group G] (hG : Nat.card G = p ^ 3) (hna : ∃ a b : G, a * b ≠ b * a) (hp2 : p ≠ 2) : ∃ φ : G →* Subgroup.center G, ∀ g : G, ((φ g : Subgroup.center G) : G) = g ^ p
closed: ∀ (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (G : Type*) [Group G] (hG : Nat.card G = p ^ 3) (hna : ∃ a b : G, a * b ≠ b * a) (hp2 : p ≠ 2), ∃ φ : G →* Subgroup.center G, ∀ g : G, ((φ g : Subgroup.center G) : G) = g ^ p
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld3_pow_prime_mem_center_of_card_prime_cube and Mathlib2.bld3_mul_pow_prime_of_card_prime_cube: define φ g = ⟨g^p, _⟩ using pow_prime_mem_center for membership; map_mul is exactly (ab)^p = a^p b^p from mul_pow_prime (p odd), map_one is one_pow.
type: ∀ (p : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → ∀ (G : Type u_1) [inst : Group G], Nat.card G = p ^ 3 → (∃ a b, a * b ≠ b * a) → p ≠ 2 → ∃ φ, ∀ (g : G), ↑(φ g) = g ^ p
